actual_tools: UniProtKB reviewed SV1 records and Python 3 standard library
execution.implementation: Genuine Rosalind task-chooser observation plus deterministic comparison of three retained UniProtKB-reviewed RAS sequences

observations: All three retained reviewed SV1 sequences contain 189 amino acids and occupy 191 alignment columns.
The direct recomputation identified 154 invariant and 37 variable alignment columns.
The four retained KRAS motif intervals are identical across KRAS, NRAS, and HRAS.
A genuine Rosalind Workbench open call returned the exact task-chooser-ready message.
interpretation: The retained alignment shows a highly conserved catalytic core accompanied by greater sequence divergence toward the C termini.
limitations: The center-star alignment is exploratory and does not provide a publication-grade evolutionary model.
Sequence divergence alone does not establish biochemical or clinical effects.
rosalind_open only opened the task chooser and did not run a RAS analysis.

provenance.note: The retained UniProt records and local script support the sequence results; the separate 891-byte Rosalind observation supports launcher readiness only.

reproduction: Run python showcases/rosalind-workbench/cases/rosalind-ras-isoforms/build_case.py from the repository root.
Require the expected three accessions, equal aligned widths, and a self-consistent variable-site table.
Treat the Rosalind launcher receipt separately from the computed sequence evidence.
